parts.text: FastAPI returns a 500 on startup after a dependency bump.

This matches BUG-1001 (FastAPI service returns 500 on startup after dependency bump), caused by upgrading Pydantic from v1 to v2 where models fail with PydanticUserError. Resolution: migrate class Config to model_config = ConfigDict(...), run bump-pydantic, call model_rebuild() on models with forward references, and pin pydantic>=2.5.
Our service is failing with Postgres 'FATAL: sorry, too many clients already' under load.

This matches BUG-1004 (Postgres 'too many connections' from connection pool exhaustion). Resolution: configure a bounded connection pool (such as SQLAlchemy pool_size and max_overflow) sized across replicas or place PgBouncer in front of PostgreSQL.
Container crashes immediately on startup with KeyError: 'DATABASE_URL' when reading config.

This matches BUG-1002 (KeyError on startup reading configuration). Resolution: read configuration safely via os.environ.get or validated startup settings, and ensure DATABASE_URL is injected into the deployment environment.
